title: Common Table Expressions (CTE)
description: Using WITH (CTE), write a query that finds the top 2 products by total revenue (quantity * price) for each category. Use a CTE to compute product revenue, then ROW_NUMBER to rank within categories.
hints: Compute quantity * price as revenue, join order_items with products
Then use a second CTE or subquery for ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY category ...)
